# speckit mermaid render

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Render Mermaid source to SVG or PNG (pure Rust, no mmdc)

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit mermaid render [OPTIONS] --from <PATH> --to <PATH>
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit mermaid render --help
```
